shared_elements: incised linear marks / possible inscribed signs on a stone surface
justification: The only possible correspondence is that both surfaces bear shallow incised linear marks that could be read as script or sign-like strokes, which is an extremely generic feature. A is dominated by a three-dimensional standing human figure carved in high relief against a pillar, with columns of neat inscription behind, whereas B shows no figural imagery at all, only sparse angular scratches on an undecorated wall.
